name: text-input
title: Text Input
description: Notched-outline text input with floating label, three sizes (sm / md / lg), five states (Default / Active / Input / Error / Disabled), prefix and suffix slots, leading and trailing icons, an inline primary CTA, and supporting helper / error text. Trailing icon can be made clickable for clear / reveal patterns. Pixel-perfect port of Figma node 66:685 (Pantheon › Text Input).
